title: DEArt: Dataset of European Art
findings: Computer vision models trained on the DEArt dataset can successfully detect religious objects and figures (e.g., angels, halos, monks, crucifixion scenes) common in European art. This approach significantly outperforms models trained on generic photograph datasets (like MS COCO), which are unable to recognize these cultural heritage-specific, often religious, classes.
